preparation.method: Identical compiled probe, native64/512 maps, ocean/mixed borders, MockGL real Mesh uploads. Shared original terrain prebuilt and excluded.3 warmup/7 timed cold background rebuilds:median/min/max; first cold includes JIT. Allocation optional (-1 unavailable on stripped Steam runtime). Separate10000 cache-hit calls. No concurrent regressions or game processes; not GPU/FPS.
